resources.string: Choose the folder containing .nds files; subfolders are supported. Tap “Use this folder”, not a storage root. After the first scan, TwinGrid matches offline details and organizes covers once. Offline downloads wait; pause them in Tasks. The setting controls later automatic fills; an explicit off choice blocks automatic starts.
Identify existing saves in the library. Finding and launching games still works; saves are never moved or modified. Choose now or add it later in Settings → Game folders.

Tasks organize game information: match names, genres and Chinese/English descriptions from the offline catalog, then fill missing covers when online. View progress, pause or resume cover downloads, and review items that need a choice. Tasks do not download games or change saves. To add games, choose a game folder in Settings.
Could not read folder. Retry or check access.
No game folder added\nTap to choose a game folder
Scan in progress. No matching games found yet.
Retry scan or choose another folder
Save folder not configured; game scan continues
Reading save status; games are available
Preparing offline information; local games can be started
Previous scan was interrupted. Scan again.

Game loading is unconfirmed. TwinGrid folder access is for TwinGrid only; save access displays status and does not authorize the emulator. Complete setup in DraStic and manually load the same file for comparison. Manual loading and selecting a game in TwinGrid are separate actions; returning never resends a request. An unverified Android build meeting public-entry and safety conditions can be tried by selecting the target again and explicitly consenting to a compatibility trial. Record the actual result.

This historical request was blocked because the build was unverified; it is not a permanent restriction in this version. If public-entry and safety conditions are met, select the game again and explicitly consent to a compatibility trial. Old requests are never replayed.
DraStic is not installed. Install a compatible version first.

The public emulator entry is unavailable or does not meet safe launch conditions. Open the emulator manually for comparison and export the last 8 requests; repeatedly choosing the game folder will not fix this.

TwinGrid cannot read the selected document or storage volume. Check that storage is available; choose the game folder again only if its access grant has expired. This does not grant access to the emulator.
Request sent to emulator; game loading is unconfirmed
No verified direct-launch method for this file location
Game-folder check failed; previous configuration retained
Checking read access. You can skip this step; game scanning will continue.

In this historical record, TwinGrid did not send a request because the build was unknown; incompatibility was not proven. This version supports an explicitly approved Android-build trial when public-entry and safety conditions are met. Select the target again and confirm; old requests are never replayed. You can also load the same file manually in the emulator for comparison and export the last 8 requests.

DraStic does not have storage read permission. Open it, complete its initial setup, check its storage permission, and manually load the same file. TwinGrid folder or save access does not grant permission to DraStic. Returning never retries automatically. Once readable, select the game and launch explicitly.

This file location or provider has no verified direct-launch route. Select the same file manually in DraStic and export diagnostics. There is no need to move or rename the game. TwinGrid access does not guarantee equivalent emulator access.

The system rejected this launch request. Open DraStic manually to check its entry and permissions, then export the last 8 requests. This does not establish that game-folder access has expired. Returning never resends the request.
Save folder could not be verified
The folder is unreadable or its permission was not retained. Your previous setting and game scan are preserved. Choose a readable save folder or try later in Settings → Game folders.
No matches for these filters yet; still scanning
Diagnostic export failed. The original diagnostic is retained; choose another destination and retry.

The selected file has moved, changed, or is incomplete. Check the original file and storage, rescan, then select the target again. Resuming the previous game is not successful loading of the new target.
Launch checking timed out; no game request was sent. Retry explicitly later and check storage responsiveness. A timeout alone does not require choosing the folder again.
This launch was canceled; no game request was sent. This request did not replace the existing emulator session. Returning never retries automatically. Select the target again when ready.

The emulator or receiving environment changed during confirmation; no game request was sent. Select the current target again and reconfirm any applicable compatibility trial. The old request will not continue.

Launch checking could not complete; the cause is undetermined and no request was sent. Retry explicitly later; if it recurs, export the last 8 requests. This does not establish an access-grant or emulator-compatibility problem.
